models.name: Splendor Plus
models.notes: Warranty: 5 years / 70,000 km. Service every 90 days or 3,000 km after free services.

models.name: HF Deluxe
models.notes: Budget commuter. Oil top-up every 1,500 km.

models.name: Glamour / Glamour X
models.notes: FI model. Brake fluid: replace every 30,000 km or 2 years, whichever earlier.

models.name: Xtreme 160R 4V
models.notes: Recommended oil: 10W-30 semi-synthetic. Break-in: avoid >5,000 rpm until 1,000 km.

models.name: Xpulse 200 4V
models.notes: Off-road: check chain and air filter more frequently. Long travel suspension needs regular fork oil monitoring.

models.name: Karizma XMR 250

maintenance.interval: Top-up every service / Replace every 2 years

models.notes: Liquid-cooled engine. Monitor coolant level. Use manufacturer-recommended fully synthetic 10W-40.

models.name: Splendor Plus / HF Deluxe / HF 100
models.notes: India's best-selling commuters. Warranty: 5 years/70,000 km. Service every 90 days or 3,000 km. 10W-30 mineral oil. Extremely low running costs.

models.name: Glamour / Super Splendor / Passion
models.notes: FI 125 cc commuters. Brake fluid: every 2 years or 30,000 km. ECU reset improves fuel delivery.

models.name: Karizma XMR 210 / Mavrick 440
models.notes: Mavrick 440 shares Harley X440 platform. Karizma is LC DOHC. 10W-40 fully synthetic for both.

models.name: Harley-Davidson X440 (Hero variant)
models.notes: Co-developed with Harley. See Harley X440 entry for full details. Hero services this at their network.

models.name: Classic 350 / Meteor 350 / Hunter 350 / Bullet 350

maintenance.interval: Clean 10,000 km / Replace 20,000 km (more in dusty conditions)

models.notes: J-platform engine. Service interval is 5,000 km or 6 months. Valve checks are unusually frequent — every 5,000 km. Use RE Liquid Gun 20W50 semi-synthetic or 10W50 fully synthetic.

models.name: Himalayan 450 / Guerrilla 450

maintenance.interval: Check every service / Replace every 2 years

models.notes: Skipping the 500 km break-in service can reduce engine life by 30–40%. Liquid-cooled Sherpa 450 engine. Use RE-approved fully synthetic 10W-40.

models.name: Interceptor 650 / Continental GT 650
models.notes: Parallel twin 270° crank. Use RE Liquid Gun 10W50 fully synthetic. Valve check every 5,000 km is a known quirk. Oil cooler on frame — inspect for leaks.

models.name: Super Meteor 650 / Shotgun 650 / Bear 650
models.notes: USD front forks on Super Meteor 650. Use the Sherpa-specific fork oil. These models share the 650 twin platform.

models.name: Pulsar NS160 / NS200

maintenance.interval: Check every service / Replace every 2 years

models.notes: Liquid-cooled 4V SOHC. Keep revs below 4,000 rpm for first 1,000 km and 5,000 rpm for next 1,000 km. 5-year engine warranty.

models.name: Pulsar N250 / F250
models.notes: Oil-cooled SOHC single. Use Bajaj-approved 20W-40 semi-synthetic or 10W-40 fully synthetic.

models.name: Pulsar NS400Z
models.notes: KTM-derived 373 cc liquid-cooled engine. Use 10W-40 fully synthetic.

models.name: Dominar 250 / Dominar 400
models.notes: Dominar 400 shares platform with KTM 390. USD forks. 10W-40 fully synthetic. Great tourer but service costs higher due to LC engine.

models.name: Bajaj Chetak (EV)
models.notes: IP67 battery protection. Retro styling. No engine oil or spark plugs. Service at Bajaj-authorised Chetak centres.

models.name: CB Shine 125 / SP 125
models.notes: 125 cc reliable commuter. Honda recommends 10W-30 mineral oil. Extremely low maintenance cost.

models.name: Unicorn 160 / SP 160
models.notes: Reliable workhorse 160 cc. Honda recommends 10W-30 semi-synthetic.

models.name: CB Hornet 2.0
models.notes: FI engine. 10W-30 semi-synthetic recommended. Inspect ABS sensor wiring regularly.

models.name: CB300R / NX200
models.notes: Honda's longer service intervals apply. 10W-40 semi-synthetic. Very low long-term maintenance cost.

models.name: CB500F / CB500X
models.notes: Parallel twin, very smooth. 10W-40 full synthetic for CB500X. Great long-distance machine.

models.name: CB Shine / SP 125 / Livo
models.notes: 125 cc Honda commuters. 10W-30 mineral. Extremely reliable and low cost. No coolant required.

models.name: Unicorn 160 / SP 160 / Hornet 2.0
models.notes: Dependable Honda 160 family. 10W-30 semi-synthetic. FI on Hornet 2.0 — inspect ABS wiring periodically.

models.name: FZ-FI / FZ-S FI (V3/V4)

maintenance.interval: Inspect each service / Replace as needed

models.notes: Free services: 1,000 km (30 days), 4,000 km (150 days), 7,000 km (270 days), 10,000 km (390 days). Paid service every 3,000 km / 120 days thereafter.

models.name: FZ25 / FZS25
models.notes: Air-cooled 250 cc — simple and affordable to maintain. Suitable for highways.

models.name: MT-15 Ver 2.0

maintenance.interval: Check every service / Replace every 2 years

models.notes: VVA liquid-cooled engine. 10W-40 semi-synthetic. Shares platform with R15 V4.

models.name: R15 V4 / R15S

maintenance.interval: Check every service / Replace every 2 years

models.notes: VVA tech. Short 3,000 km service cycle due to typical city use. 10W-40 semi-synthetic or fully synthetic. Avoid track riding without cooling upgrade.

models.name: MT-03 / R3
models.notes: 321 cc parallel twin DOHC. Longer valve check intervals. 10W-40 full synthetic recommended. Pairs well as first step-up bike.

models.name: MT-15 Ver 2.0 / R15 V4 / R15S
models.notes: VVA LC engine. 10W-40 semi-synthetic. Short 3,000 km service cycle due to city use.

models.name: MT-03 / R3 / XSR 155
models.notes: 321 cc DOHC parallel twin. Long valve intervals. 10W-40 fully synthetic.

models.name: Apache RTR 160 4V

maintenance.interval: Front 28 PSI / Rear 32 PSI — check before each ride

models.notes: TVS recommends 20W-40 semi-synthetic (TVS TRU4 PREMIUM). Chain lube every 500–600 km is shorter than most — stick to it. Fork oil: 140±2 ml per leg (Gabriel) or 152±2 ml (Top make).

models.name: Apache RTR 200 4V
models.notes: Oil-cooled. TVS TRU4 Premium 20W-40. Throttle body cleaning at ~20,000 km recommended. Clutch plates may need attention at 22,000–28,000 km.

models.name: Apache RR 310
models.notes: BMW G 310 R-derived engine. Liquid cooled. Use 10W-40 fully synthetic. USD forks. One of the most track-capable bikes made in India.

models.name: Raider 125
models.notes: Sporty 125 cc commuter. TVS TRU4 20W-40. Very affordable maintenance.

models.name: Raider 125 / Star City+
models.notes: TVS TRU4 20W-40. Chain lube every 500–600 km — shorter than most brands.

models.name: iQube / iQube S / iQube ST (EV)
models.notes: TVS's electric scooter. No engine oil, spark plugs, or clutch. Serviced at TVS workshops. 5,000 km service interval. Regenerative braking reduces brake pad wear.

models.name: 125 Duke

maintenance.interval: Check every service / Replace every 4 years

models.notes: KTM recommends fully synthetic 10W-50. Service interval wider than earlier gens. Trellis frame benefits from periodic check of all bolts.

models.name: 200 Duke

maintenance.interval: Check every service / Replace every 4 years

models.notes: WP suspension. Fully synthetic 10W-50 mandatory (conventional oil will overheat the LC engine). Service cost ₹2,500–3,000 typically.

models.name: 250 Duke

maintenance.interval: Check every service / Replace every 4 years

models.notes: Similar platform to 200 Duke. Ride-by-wire from 2024 refresh. 10W-50 fully synthetic. Coolant: 4-year change interval.

models.name: 390 Duke (2024+)

maintenance.task: Engine oil + filter + air filter change

maintenance.interval: Check every service / Replace every 4 years

models.notes: 2024 gen has wider service intervals: oil every 10,000 km. Valve check pushed to 20,000 km. 10W-50 fully synthetic only. TFT dash, traction control — keep software updated.

models.name: 390 Adventure / 390 SMC R

maintenance.task: Engine oil + filter + air filter change

maintenance.interval: Every 1,000 km (500 km off-road for ADV)

models.notes: Off-road riding demands more frequent air filter and chain checks. Cornering ABS. 10W-50 fully synthetic only.

models.name: 125 Duke / 200 Duke / 250 Duke
models.notes: KTM-family LC singles. 10W-50 fully synthetic mandatory. WP suspension. Trellis frame — check all bolts periodically. Service cost ₹2,500–3,000.

models.name: SR 125 / Storm 125 (Scooter)
models.notes: Piaggio i-Get engine. Use 5W-40 semi-synthetic. CVT belt check is critical — failure strands the rider.

models.name: RS 457 / Tuono 457
models.notes: Made in India (Baramati). Service every 6,000 km or 6 months. No labour charges within warranty. 10W-40 fully synthetic. O-ring, flywheel cap and fork plug O-rings: replace at each service.

models.name: 450S / 450X / 450 Apex

maintenance.interval: Front 30 PSI / Rear 35 PSI — before every ride

models.notes: No engine oil, spark plugs, clutch, or air filter. Service every 5,000 km is usage-based. Ather recommends daily charging to 80–90% and avoiding deep discharge. Book via Ather app.

models.name: Rizta
models.notes: Family-oriented electric scooter. Spacious boot, comfortable ride. Same 5,000 km service interval as 450 range. No traditional engine maintenance.

models.name: Imperiale 400

maintenance.interval: Every 500 km and after every wash

models.notes: Air-cooled SOHC single. 10W-40 semi-synthetic. Chain: lube every 500 km and after every rain/wash — strict Benelli spec. Warranty: 4 years/50,000 km.

models.name: TRK 502 / TRK 502X
models.notes: 499 cc parallel twin, LC. 10W-40 semi-synthetic. Chain lube every 500 km is Benelli's spec for all models. TRK 502X adds off-road capability.

models.name: 502C / Leoncino 500
models.notes: Same 499 cc LC twin platform. All Benelli 500-series bikes share same service schedule. 10W-40 recommended.

models.name: G 310 R

maintenance.task: Coolant (no specified change interval — monitor level)

models.notes: Made with TVS in India. 10,000 km oil service interval — widest in its class in India. BMW Shell 10W-40 recommended. 10W-50 for track days. Major service every 40,000 km includes steering bearings.

models.name: G 310 GS
models.notes: Same engine as G 310 R. Wider bars, more suspension travel, spoked wheels. 10,000 km service interval is a major advantage. BMW LL-04 or Shell 10W-40.

models.name: F 900 R / F 900 XR
models.notes: 895 cc parallel twin. BMW LL-04 fully synthetic. Flagship middleweight in India. Valve checks at 10,000 km. Service at BMW Motorrad dealer only for warranty.

models.name: S 1000 R / S 1000 RR
models.notes: Inline-4 superbike. BMW LL-04 10W-60 fully synthetic. Track riders: shorten oil interval to 5,000 km. ABS / Dynamic Traction Control software — update regularly.

models.name: 300NK
models.notes: LC single. 10W-40 semi-synthetic. Good entry-level naked. Reduce service interval by 50% in severe conditions (dusty/off-road).

models.name: 450MT / 450NK
models.notes: LC parallel twin. 10W-40 fully synthetic. Excellent value ADV. Pierer Mobility (KTM parent) partnership ensures quality.

models.name: 650MT / 650NK

maintenance.interval: Every 42,000 km (DOHC twin — very wide interval)

models.notes: 649 cc LC DOHC parallel twin. Valve check at 42,000 km is one of the widest intervals anywhere. 10W-40 semi-synthetic. Great value against Kawasaki Versys 650.

models.name: Scrambler 400
models.notes: Desmodromic valve system requires specialist service — no valve springs, driven close and open mechanically. Do NOT attempt DIY without Ducati training. Service cost significantly higher than rivals. 10W-50 fully synthetic.

models.name: Scrambler 800 / Icon / Nightshift
models.notes: L-twin Desmodue. Same Desmo valve service requirement. 10W-50. Coolant check if oil-cooler variant. Budget ₹10,000–15,000 per service for Desmo work.

models.name: Monster 937
models.notes: LC Testastretta 11° Desmo twin. Ducati's most popular model globally. 10W-50 fully synthetic. Desmo service is approximately ₹15,000–25,000 at authorised dealer.

models.name: X440 (Denim / Vivid / S)
models.notes: Built by Hero MotoCorp for Indian market. 440 cc air-oil cooled SOHC single. 10W-40 or 15W-50 fully synthetic. KYB inverted forks. Dual-channel ABS. Wider service window than typical Indians/Harleys.

models.name: Svartpilen 250 / Vitpilen 250

maintenance.interval: Check every service / Replace every 4 years

models.notes: KTM 250 cc platform, Husqvarna tuning. Shares service schedule with KTM 250 Duke. 10W-50 fully synthetic. Scandinavia-meets-India styling.

models.name: Svartpilen 401 / Vitpilen 401

maintenance.interval: Check every service / Replace every 4 years

models.notes: KTM 390 platform, Husqvarna styling. DOHC valve adjustment requires shim removal — workshop recommended. 10W-50 fully synthetic. WP Apex suspension.

models.name: Jawa 42 / 42 Bobber / 42 FJ
models.notes: Classic Legends (Mahindra). LC single, 10W-40. Service costs: ~₹1,500 (1st), ~₹1,300 (2nd), ~₹2,800 (3rd), ~₹5,300 (4th at 18,000 km). 4 year/50,000 km warranty. 42 Bobber adds assist-slipper clutch.

models.name: Jawa 350 / Perak
models.notes: Perak is single-seater bobber. Same LC engine platform. Classic retro Czech heritage meets Mahindra reliability. 10W-40 recommended.

models.name: Ninja 300 / Z300
models.notes: Parallel twin LC DOHC. Very wide 12,000 km service interval. Fully synthetic 10W-40. Last imported units — replaced by Ninja 400.

models.name: Ninja 400 / Z400
models.notes: Best-in-class parallel twin for learners. Very wide valve service interval. 10W-40 fully synthetic. One of the best beginner bikes globally.

models.name: Z650 / Ninja 650 / Versys 650
models.notes: Popular parallel twin platform. One of the most generous valve service intervals in the segment. 10W-40 fully synthetic. Versys: chain lube more frequently on tours.

models.name: SR125 / Vieste 300
models.notes: Budget Italian-branded Chinese motorcycles. 10W-40 semi-synthetic. Entry-level ownership. Limited service network — verify dealer availability in your city before purchase.

models.name: Mojo 300
models.notes: Powerful LC single with DOHC, 4-valve. 21 L fuel tank. 10W-40 semi-synthetic. Mojo has a cult following for highway touring. Limited production.

models.name: Praise Pro / iPraise+ / OKHI 90
models.notes: Domestic EV brand. No engine oil, spark plugs, or gearbox. Battery warranty varies by model. Service at Okinawa-authorised centres. Avoid deep discharge below 20%.

models.name: S1 / S1 Pro / S1 Air / S1 X

maintenance.interval: Before every ride — 36 PSI front / 40 PSI rear
Accept when prompted — mandatory for performance

models.notes: India's #1 selling EV scooter by volume. No traditional engine maintenance. OTA updates improve range/performance. Ola Hypercharger at select stations. 3-year vehicle warranty / 8-year battery. Book service on Ola app.

models.name: S1 Gen 3 / Roadster / Gig
models.notes: Gen 3 has improved range and performance. Roadster targets enthusiast market. All Ola EVs: charge regularly, avoid complete discharge. Accept OTA updates for best results.

models.name: RV400 / RV400 BRZ
models.notes: India's first AI-enabled electric motorcycle. Has chain drive — unlike most EVs. 8-year / 1,50,000 km battery warranty. MyRevolt app for service booking. No engine oil. 75–150 km claimed range depending on mode.

models.name: Gixxer 155 / Gixxer SF 155
models.notes: Suzuki extended service interval from 4,000 km to 6,000 km. Air-cooled FI. 10W-40 SAE API SL. Low maintenance cost. Chain lube every 1,000 km.

models.name: Gixxer 250 / Gixxer SF 250
models.notes: Air-cooled 250 cc single. 10W-40 semi-synthetic. Competitive with R3 and MT-03 on pricing.

models.name: V-Strom 250 SX
models.notes: Single-cylinder V-Strom for India. Large 17.3 L tank for touring. Air-cooled. 10W-40.

models.name: V-Strom 800 DE / GSX-8R / Hayabusa
models.notes: Hayabusa: 1,340 cc inline-4 — service every 6,000 km still. Suzuki 10W-40 full synthetic for all three. V-Strom 800 DE has long valve intervals — a major ownership advantage.

models.name: Speed 400
models.notes: Class-leading 16,000 km service interval. Finger-follower DLC-coated valvetrain allows 32,000 km valve check. Dealer software update mandatory at each service. 10W-40 fully synthetic.

models.name: Scrambler 400 X
models.notes: Same 398 cc engine as Speed 400. 19-inch front wheel, off-road protection. Same 16,000 km service schedule. Off-road: check chain more frequently.

models.name: Tiger Sport 660

maintenance.interval: Every 32,000 km with cam timing check

models.notes: 660 cc inline triple. 10W-40 fully synthetic. Same 16,000 km oil interval. Cam timing check at valve service. Excellent Sport-ADV at accessible price.

models.name: Vida V1 Pro / V1 Plus / V2
models.notes: Hero's EV brand — backed by Hero MotoCorp's 6,000+ service network. No engine oil, spark plugs, or clutch. Hub motor design. 3-year/40,000 km vehicle warranty. Vida app for connectivity and OTA.

models.name: Yezdi Roadster
models.notes: Shares platform with Jawa 42. Same LC 293 cc engine. All Jawa/Yezdi: service costs ₹1,500/₹1,300/₹2,800/₹5,300 at 1k/6k/12k/18k km. 4-year/50,000 km warranty.

models.name: Yezdi Scrambler

maintenance.interval: All Yezdi OBD2 updates include sprocket changes

models.notes: Off-road use: inspect chain and air filter more frequently. Rear sprocket enlarged in OBD2 update for better acceleration. Same platform as Roadster.

models.name: Yezdi Adventure
models.notes: Most capable of the Yezdi trio for off-road. Same 293 cc LC engine. Larger fuel tank. 10W-40 semi-synthetic recommended.
